cases.description: Names a temporary workaround (pinning the CI runner's Python version) explicitly tied to an upstream issue that is not yet fixed — a genuine candidate for a known-limitations entry that names the real fix still owed (unpin once the upstream wheel-building issue resolves), not just a note that a workaround exists. No module is named nearby, so priority fails closed to MEDIUM rather than being treated as low-priority just because it's 'only' a workaround. Recommendation: capture with an explicit trigger condition for revisiting (upstream fix ships) so this doesn't silently become permanent, undocumented technical debt.
cases.grounding: knowledge_scanner.scan matches 'workaround-explicit'; location_resolver.resolve_mention returns None; priority_scorer.compute_priority(None, ci_has_warning=False) returns MEDIUM.
